CELINA PAUL Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India | +91 9789850302| paulcelina1994@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/celinapaul- a50153167

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Business Analyst with 8.5 years of experience delivering business transformation and process improvement initiatives across Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Fund Accounting and Financial Reporting within global banking environments. Strong expertise in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, AS-IS / TO-BE process mapping, gap and impact analysis, BRD/FRD development, user stories and UAT across Agile Scrum and Waterfall environments. Experienced in partnering with business, operations, finance and technology stakeholders to define future-state processes, identify process gaps and support operating-model and transformation initiatives. Strong domain expertise in Fund Accounting, NAV processing, trade lifecycle, security pricing, corporate actions, reconciliations and financial reporting. Led automation and reporting transformation initiatives to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and improve operational efficiency.

CORE COMPETENCIES Business Analysis & Requirements | AS-IS / TO-BE Process Mapping | Target Operating Model (TOM) Exposure | Future-State Process Design | Process Analysis & Optimization | Process Simplification & Standardization | Gap & Impact Analysis | Transformation Workshop Facilitation | Stakeholder Management | Transformation Planning | Process Automation | UAT & Change Management | Capital Markets | Investment Banking | Trade Lifecycle | Fund Accounting | NAV Validation | Security Pricing | Corporate Actions | Reconciliations | Exception Management | Financial Reporting

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

PERSOLKELLY (Client – Standard Chartered Bank) Manager – BAU Support (PSGL) | Chennai, India | Jun 2025 – Nov 2025 • Led BAU support for PeopleSoft General Ledger (PSGL), managing journal integrations from multiple

upstream systems across global entities.

Partnered with cross-functional stakeholders to perform root cause analysis, resolve integration and system issues, support data governance initiatives (Chart-Fields, GOLF, ICM), and drive process improvements that reduced journal posting defects while strengthening financial controls and operational performance. • Performed business process analysis, gap analysis and workflow optimization for journal integration processes across multiple upstream systems, improving operational efficiency and data quality.

COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS Senior Business Analyst | Chennai, India | Jul 2022 – Jul 2024 • Partnered with Finance, FP&A and Technology teams to gather business requirements for transforming

Excel-based financial reports into Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) dashboard solutions.

Conducted AS-IS / TO-BE process analysis, workflow analysis and gap analysis to understand reporting challenges, data flows, business needs and opportunities for process improvement.

Facilitated requirements and transformation workshops with Finance, FP&A, Technology and business stakeholders to understand current-state processes and define future-state reporting workflows.

Supported future-state process design by assessing business, technology, stakeholder and control impacts and translating requirements into actionable transformation initiatives.

Translated business requirements into user stories, functional specifications and change-request documentation, supporting solution delivery and implementation.

Led UAT activities and stakeholder coordination, validating OAC dashboards to improve reporting accuracy, data accessibility, decision-making and operational efficiency.

BNP PARIBAS

Senior Analyst, Global Banking and Investor Solutions | Chennai, India | Oct 2021 – Apr 2022 • Performed NAV calculations, pricing validation and reconciliation activities for hedge fund portfolios,

ensuring accuracy and timely fund closure.

Processed trades, corporate actions, subscriptions and redemptions while validating stock, cash, FX and valuation data within established controls.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to resolve reconciliation breaks, analyze exceptions and support operational efficiency and data accuracy.

SOCIÉTÉ GÉNÉRALE Senior Analyst, Global Banking and Investor Solutions | Chennai, India | Jun 2016 – Sep 2021 • Performed daily and weekly NAV calculations for Mutual Fund portfolios across equities, fixed income,

derivatives and FX, ensuring accurate fund valuation and regulatory compliance.

Performed fund accounting activities including trade processing, corporate actions, subscriptions, redemptions, fee accruals, and cash and stock reconciliations to support accurate and timely NAV calculation.

Performed security pricing using Bloomberg and internal fund accounting systems, validating market data, FX rates and pricing exceptions to ensure accurate portfolio valuation.

Partnered with Operations, Finance and Technology teams to analyse business processes, gather and document business requirements, and support system enhancement initiatives.

Led NAV automation initiatives by defining business requirements, supporting future-state process design and TOM implementation activities, and delivering process improvements through business and technology collaboration.

Coordinated UAT, defect management, stakeholder communication and change management, ensuring successful implementation of system enhancements and reporting solutions.

Analysed end-to-end fund accounting and NAV processes using AS-IS / TO-BE assessment to identify manual activities, process gaps, control issues and opportunities for simplification and standardization. • Collaborated with Operations, Finance and Technology stakeholders through transformation workshops to define process improvements, resolve operational gaps and support future-state process implementation.

SELECTED TRANSFORMATION PROJECTS • NAV Automation & Cash Reconciliation Enhancement – Automated NAV processes, reducing manual effort

and improving process efficiency; saved 20+ man-hours weekly.

Financial Reporting Dashboard Transformation – Enhanced existing dashboards and developed new financial reports, improving data accessibility and decision-making.

TOOLS, METHODOLOGIES & CERTIFICATIONS Capital Markets / Market Data: NeoXam GP3, GENEVA, NTAS, NEO Link, Viteos RECON, Bloomberg, Accurate (Cash) ERP / BI / Delivery: PeopleSoft GL, Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), JIRA, ServiceNow, MS Excel Methodologies: Agile (Scrum), Waterfall (SDLC) Certifications: Business Analysis Certification – IIBA CCBA aligned (21 PD hours) | Lean Six Sigma Green Belt

ACHIEVEMENTS • SPOT Award – Senior Management performance recognition at Société Générale. • Led NAV automation project reducing manual effort and saving 20+ man-hours weekly.

EDUCATION • Master of Business Administration (MBA), CGPA 8.042/10 – SRM University, Chennai | Jul 2014 – May 2016 • Bachelor of Commerce, Banking Management (B.Com BM), CGPA 7.16/10 – Meenakshi College for Women,

Chennai | Jun 2011 – May 2014

sections.text: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Business Analyst with 8.5 years of experience delivering business transformation and process improvement initiatives across Capital Markets, Investment Banking, Fund Accounting and Financial Reporting within global banking environments. Led automation and reporting transformation initiatives to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and improve operational efficiency.

sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
PERSOLKELLY (Client – Standard Chartered Bank) Manager – BAU Support (PSGL) | Chennai, India | Jun 2025 – Nov 2025 • Led BAU support for PeopleSoft General Ledger (PSGL), managing journal integrations from multiple
upstream systems across global entities.
Partnered with cross-functional stakeholders to perform root cause analysis, resolve integration and system issues, support data governance initiatives (Chart-Fields, GOLF, ICM), and drive process improvements that reduced journal posting defects while strengthening financial controls and operational performance. • Performed business process analysis, gap analysis and workflow optimization for journal integration processes across multiple upstream systems, improving operational efficiency and data quality.
COGNIZANT TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS Senior Business Analyst | Chennai, India | Jul 2022 – Jul 2024 • Partnered with Finance, FP&A and Technology teams to gather business requirements for transforming
Excel-based financial reports into Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) dashboard solutions.
Conducted AS-IS / TO-BE process analysis, workflow analysis and gap analysis to understand reporting challenges, data flows, business needs and opportunities for process improvement.
Facilitated requirements and transformation workshops with Finance, FP&A, Technology and business stakeholders to understand current-state processes and define future-state reporting workflows.
Supported future-state process design by assessing business, technology, stakeholder and control impacts and translating requirements into actionable transformation initiatives.
Translated business requirements into user stories, functional specifications and change-request documentation, supporting solution delivery and implementation.
Led UAT activities and stakeholder coordination, validating OAC dashboards to improve reporting accuracy, data accessibility, decision-making and operational efficiency.
BNP PARIBAS
Senior Analyst, Global Banking and Investor Solutions | Chennai, India | Oct 2021 – Apr 2022 • Performed NAV calculations, pricing validation and reconciliation activities for hedge fund portfolios,
ensuring accuracy and timely fund closure.
Processed trades, corporate actions, subscriptions and redemptions while validating stock, cash, FX and valuation data within established controls.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to resolve reconciliation breaks, analyze exceptions and support operational efficiency and data accuracy.
SOCIÉTÉ GÉNÉRALE Senior Analyst, Global Banking and Investor Solutions | Chennai, India | Jun 2016 – Sep 2021 • Performed daily and weekly NAV calculations for Mutual Fund portfolios across equities, fixed income,
derivatives and FX, ensuring accurate fund valuation and regulatory compliance.
Performed fund accounting activities including trade processing, corporate actions, subscriptions, redemptions, fee accruals, and cash and stock reconciliations to support accurate and timely NAV calculation.
Performed security pricing using Bloomberg and internal fund accounting systems, validating market data, FX rates and pricing exceptions to ensure accurate portfolio valuation.
Partnered with Operations, Finance and Technology teams to analyse business processes, gather and document business requirements, and support system enhancement initiatives.
Led NAV automation initiatives by defining business requirements, supporting future-state process design and TOM implementation activities, and delivering process improvements through business and technology collaboration.
Coordinated UAT, defect management, stakeholder communication and change management, ensuring successful implementation of system enhancements and reporting solutions.
Analysed end-to-end fund accounting and NAV processes using AS-IS / TO-BE assessment to identify manual activities, process gaps, control issues and opportunities for simplification and standardization. • Collaborated with Operations, Finance and Technology stakeholders through transformation workshops to define process improvements, resolve operational gaps and support future-state process implementation.
SELECTED TRANSFORMATION PROJECTS • NAV Automation & Cash Reconciliation Enhancement – Automated NAV processes, reducing manual effort
and improving process efficiency; saved 20+ man-hours weekly.
Financial Reporting Dashboard Transformation – Enhanced existing dashboards and developed new financial reports, improving data accessibility and decision-making.
TOOLS, METHODOLOGIES & CERTIFICATIONS Capital Markets / Market Data: NeoXam GP3, GENEVA, NTAS, NEO Link, Viteos RECON, Bloomberg, Accurate (Cash) ERP / BI / Delivery: PeopleSoft GL, Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), JIRA, ServiceNow, MS Excel Methodologies: Agile (Scrum), Waterfall (SDLC)
